name: warp
description: Pure functional event-driven devkit. Event -> Gate -> Stream -> StreamLog, plus Axiom as an enforced primitive and a unified dispatch (exact-cache / pre-generation-filter / population / cascade / axiom-gate / score-retain / escalate). v1.4 adds: canonicalization pipeline, fuzzy pre-generation reuse (opt-in), population lifecycle control (decay/pruning/dedup), two-stage generation, gate fusion, axiom cost weighting, and a structural delta cache. v1.5 adds: firstSuccessPromotionPolicy, a third pluggable promotion policy that crystallizes on one success instead of three. Zero dependencies, zero coupling to any consuming project.
author: James Brooks
decoupling_rule: warp/core and warp/dispatch import nothing outside warp/. Consuming projects import warp and supply adapters via Stream.hook().
changelog_note: See CHANGELOG.md for the full version history. v1.4 additions are opt-in and default OFF except decay/pruning being available at zero rate by default (i.e. a no-op unless configured) — existing v1.1.0 callers see zero behavior change. See dispatch/benchmark.js section 4 for real measurements; the original v1.4 patch doc's '10x-35x cheaper / 15x-50x faster' claims were not benchmarked against anything and are not repeated here.
